seo.meta_description: Newk's Eatery catering includes boxed lunches from about $12.50, sandwich and wrap bundles for groups, Q sliders, dips and whole cakes. What it costs.

question: How Much Does Newk's Catering Cost?
quick_answer: Newk's Eatery catering is built around boxed lunches and party bundles. Boxed lunches with a sandwich, side and dessert start around $12.50 to $14.50 per person, and salad boxes run about $9 to $15. Sandwich or wrap bundles that feed about 8 to 10 people cost roughly $156 to $220. Newk's also caters its Q Sliders, Southern Duo dip, soups, dessert trays and whole cakes. Prices and minimums vary by location.
key_facts: Boxed lunches from about $12.50 per person
Bundles for 8 to 10 people about $156 to $220

body.heading: Boxed lunches
body.text: Newk's boxed lunches are the most popular catering choice for offices. A Classic boxed lunch includes your choice of sandwich, a side and a dessert, for about $12.50 at some locations, and the Classic Plus adds a second side for about $14.50. Popular sandwiches include the Newk's Club, Chicken Bacon Club, Chicken Salad on a croissant and Ham & Cheese, usually on wheatberry bread. Salad boxes, like the Newk's Favorite or Ultimate Salad, cost about $9 to $15 and come with dessert.

body.heading: Bundles and trays for groups
body.text: For buffets, Newk's sells bundles that pair a sandwich or wrap tray with sides or salad. One listing shows a small sandwich bundle of 16 halves, serving 8 to 10, for about $220, while other locations offer an assorted sandwich bundle with Caesar salad and a dessert tray for about $156 serving 8. Newk's Q Sliders, made with chicken, Swiss, bacon and Newk's white BBQ sauce, run about $78 to $108 per tray.

body.heading: Appetizers, soups and desserts
body.text: Starters include a charcuterie tray, the Newk's Southern Duo of chicken salad and pimiento cheese dip, chicken or shrimp pasta salad, and a pimiento cheese ball rolled in pecans. Soups like loaded potato come by the container for 8 to 10 people. For dessert, Newk's offers trays of cookies, crispy treats and brownies, plus whole cakes with 12 slices for about $45.

body.heading: Drinks and minimums
body.text: You can add gallons of sweet or unsweet tea or lemonade, usually about $10 per gallon, along with cups and ice. Many Newk's locations have a $100 minimum for delivery and need a few hours' notice, while larger orders may need a day's notice. Delivery fees vary.

body.heading: How to order
body.text: You can order Newk's catering through its website or through catering platforms like ezCater. Newk's was founded in 2004 and has more than 100 locations across the South. For regular menu prices, see our Newk's Eatery menu page.
